reference.title: Git History View
reference.shortdesc: The controls in the Git History view.

section.title: Overview
section.p:
Open the view from the
toolbar button, from WindowShow View, or from a Show history action in a contextual Git submenu.

ul.li: A branch chooser filters the graph: all branches, all local branches, the current branch, or the current local branch.
(on by default) keeps the history in sync with the active editor.
A text filter narrows the list by message, date, author, commit ID, branch, or tag.

section.title: History Table
section.p:
Each row shows the graph, message, date, author, and commit ID, latest first. Branch and tag labels appear on their commits, the current local branch is highlighted, and hovering a branch label shows its tracking information with a
link. A grey
row represents your working copy. Right-click a commit for actions such as , , , , , and .

section.title: Commit Details and Affected Resources
section.p:
The
pane shows the commit ID, parent, author, committer, dates, and message. The
pane lists the files the commit changed. Right-click a file for these actions (which ones are available depends on how the file changed):

dlentry.dd: Opens the file as it was before this commit.
Opens the current version from your working copy.
Restores the file to its state in this commit.
Compares this commit's version with the previous one.
Compares this commit's version with your working copy.
When you select a range of commits, compares the two endpoint versions of the file.
